AB summary

The LSESU Economics Society Essay Competition is an international academic essay competition run by the London School of Economics Students' Union Economics Society in partnership with ASEEDER.

The 2026 competition is currently accepting submissions, with a final deadline of September 1, 2026 at 23:59 GMT+1. Late submissions are not accepted.

Entrants choose one of five economics questions and may submit only one essay. Essays must be written in English and may contain up to 1,500 words.

According to the official rules, the competition accepts students globally and is particularly recommended for students who have just completed their penultimate or final year of secondary school and those entering university in the 2026/27 academic year.

Plagiarism and AI-generated content are prohibited. Awards include certificates signed by LSESU Economics Society leadership and various Amazon gift cards.

Eligibility

Participants may come from countries worldwide.The competition is particularly recommended for students who have just completed their penultimate or final year of secondary school.Students entering university in the 2026/27 academic year may also be eligible.Each entrant may submit one essay responding to one question.The essay must be in English and must not contain plagiarism or AI-generated content.
